name: now-focus
title: Now Focus
description: Show and switch your now CLI focus from the menu bar and a list with actions.
author: shanberg

commands.name: menu-bar-focus
commands.title: Current Focus
commands.description: Show current now focus in the menu bar.

commands.name: list-focus
commands.title: Focus List
commands.description: View focusable items and set focus or complete from a list.

preferences.name: focusFilePath
preferences.title: Focus file path
preferences.description: Path to your .now.md focus file. Use ~ for home (e.g. ~/.now/focus.now.md).

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
